2608.18516.title: OptiModNet: A UNet-Transformer Hybrid with Grouped-Query and Channel Attention for Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
2608.18516.paper_summary: Precise segmentation of the optic disc and cup is critical for the early detection and diagnosis of glaucoma. However, achieving consistently high performance across datasets while maintaining low computational requirements remains a significant challenge. In glaucoma detection, low-computation methods are crucial for enabling rapid, large-scale screening and facilitating deployment in resource-limited clinical environments. While deep learning models such as UNets, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Diffusion models have demonstrated strong segmentation performance but these methods often come with substantial computational overhead. UNets are efficient at capturing local features but are limited in modeling global contextual information. Conversely, ViTs excel at long-range dependency modeling but are computationally intensive. Hybrid architectures, such as UNetR, which combine transformer-based encoders with UNet-style decoders, have shown improved performance but while incurring additional complexity. Considering these, in this work, we propose OptiModNet, a light weight novel hybrid architecture tailored for optic disc and cup segmentation. The model integrates diverse attention mechanisms at multiple stages of the network to enhance both local and global feature representation. We include an Aggregated Pyramid Loss that supervises predictions at multiple decoder depths, to promote better gradient flow and structural consistency. We evaluate OptiModNet on the REFUGE2 dataset for both optic disc and cup segmentation tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, exceeding existing approaches by over 2.5\%, while maintaining high efficiency with only 3.73 GFLOPs and 1.93M parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/SG1947/OptiModNet.
2608.18516.paper_summary_zh: 精確的視神經盤和杯的分割對於青光眼的早期檢測和診斷至關重要。<lb/>然而，在保持低計算需求的同時，實現跨數據集的一致高性能仍然是一個重大挑戰。<lb/>在青光眼檢測中，低計算方法對於實現快速的大規模篩查和促進在資源有限的臨床環境中的部署至關重要。<lb/>雖然深度學習模型如UNets、視覺Transformer（ViTs）和擴散模型已顯示出強大的分割性能，但這些方法通常伴隨著可觀的計算開銷。<lb/>UNets在捕捉局部特徵方面效率高，但在建模全局上下文信息方面有限。<lb/>相反，ViTs在長距離依賴建模方面表現出色，但計算密集。<lb/>混合架構，如UNetR，將基於Transformer的編碼器與UNet風格的解碼器相結合，顯示出改進的性能，但同時增加了額外的複雜性。<lb/>考慮到這些，在本研究中，我們提出了OptiModNet，一種針對視神經盤和杯分割量身定制的輕量級新型混合架構。<lb/>該模型在網絡的多個階段整合了多樣的注意力機制，以增強局部和全局特徵表示。<lb/>我們包括了一個聚合金字塔損失，該損失在多個解碼器深度上監督預測，以促進更好的梯度流動和結構一致性。<lb/>我們在REFUGE2數據集上評估OptiModNet，針對視神經盤和杯的分割任務。<lb/>我們的方法達到了最先進的性能，超過現有方法超過2.5\%，同時保持高效率，僅需3.73 GFLOPs和1.93M參數。<lb/>代碼可在https://github.com/SG1947/OptiModNet獲得。
